structure.code_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Cannot be changed later.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.settings_hint: Type-specific validation, such as max_length. Metric attributes need metric_family and default_unit.
attributes.invalid_settings: Settings must be a JSON object.
attributes.no_options: This attribute has no options yet.

groups.title: Attribute groups
groups.no_members: No attributes in this group yet. An attribute joins a group from its own page.

association_types.title: Association types
association_types.description: How products relate: cross-sell, accessories, compatible parts (two-way), bundles and kits (quantified).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Independent category trees: each root category is a tree.
categories.no_branch: No categories beneath this one yet.
categories.move_hint: Change to move this category, with everything beneath it. Empty to make it a tree.
categories.filed_counts: {products} product(s) and {models} product model(s) are filed here.
categories.confirm_delete: Delete this category and everything beneath it?

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where products are published, in which locales and currencies, and the locales content is written in.
channels.locale_code_hint: A language, optionally with a region: en, en_US.
channels.currencies_hint: ISO codes, separated by commas: USD, EUR.
channels.delete_note: Deleting a channel also removes every value scoped to it.
channels.confirm_delete: Delete this channel, and every value scoped to it?

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Commercial markers (restricted, pricing only, clearance) that products and owners carry. An owner's flags reach everything beneath it.
flags.delete_note: A flag still assigned to a product or owner cannot be deleted; remove it from them first.
